Five questionnaires are focal and are always analysed alongside each other: the State-Trait Inventory for Cognitive and Somatic Anxiety (STICSA, state and trait form), the Intolerance of Uncertainty scale (IU), the Beck Depression Inventory (BDI) and the Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory (OCI). Five further questionnaires belong to the wider battery (PCL, ACE, EAT, SIAS, ERS). The statistical models that relate the focal questionnaires to behaviour are described in
The numbers and figures of this section refer to the participants who have both behavioural and questionnaire data (N = 65; None = 23, Partial = 29, Full = 13; run
and are descriptive: no tests are computed.
